symptom: After the category signedness migration completed, an older pending migration attempted to create the account owner/account-number unique index already created by the approved recovery path.

evidence.existing_definition: The recovery path created the exact approved unique index over user_id and account_number_full.

root_cause.summary: The historical account-uniqueness migration lacked an idempotency guard for an exact pre-existing approved index.

actions_attempted: Added a bounded source guard that accepts only the exact named unique index with the exact ordered columns.
Retained the historical duplicate-row check and create path when the index is absent.
Rebuilt the backend and repeated Compose startup against the preserved volume.
Verified all three services healthy and bounded HTTP reachability.
resolution: The historical migration now returns only for an exact compatible unique index and rejects an incompatible same-name definition.
prevention: Make cumulative constraint migrations verify and accept exact compatible definitions before attempting creation.
